verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a configurable customer risk-score equation and alert or case workflows for transaction monitoring. Nothing documents that an individual score or transaction alert returns its top contributing risk factors or reason codes. The configurable equation is an adjacent transparency control, not per-score explanations, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, every score comes with its top risk factors — why this transaction looks risky — not just an opaque number
